name: @shotkit/scripts
description: Repository scripts, one directory per command group: build, verify, ci, perf, package, tree, docs. TypeScript, run with tsx through the aliases in the root package.json. Reach for a library before writing a utility; see CLAUDE.md.

scripts.test: tsx --test build/*.test.ts ci/*.test.ts lib/*.test.ts package/*.test.ts tree/*.test.ts
